{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PaymentProcessor where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Crypto.KDF.BCrypt (validatePassword, hashPassword)
import System.IO

data AuthResult = AuthSuccess | AuthFailure | AuthLocked
  deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { auditTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , auditUser     :: ByteString
  , auditAction   :: String
  , auditResult   :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data RateLimitState = RateLimitState
  { failedAttempts :: Int
  , windowStart   :: UTCTime
  , lockedUntil   :: Maybe UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

data PaymentEnv = PaymentEnv
  { credentials   :: MVar (Map ByteString ByteString)
  , rateLimits    :: MVar (Map ByteString RateLimitState)
  , auditLog      :: MVar [AuditEntry]
  , maxAttempts   :: Int
  , windowSeconds :: NominalDiffTime
  , lockDuration  :: NominalDiffTime
  }

-- A precomputed bcrypt hash of a random/unknown password, used as a decoy
-- so that authentication of a non-existent user performs the same amount of
-- work (a full bcrypt verification) as authentication of an existing user.
-- This prevents username enumeration via timing side-channels.
decoyHash :: ByteString
decoyHash = "$2b$12$C6UzMDM.H6dfI/f/IKcEeO3T3rXjP3f6h6XvSjP2p5t5v5t5v5t5u"

initEnv :: IO PaymentEnv
initEnv = do
  creds <- newMVar Map.empty
  rates <- newMVar Map.empty
  audit <- newMVar []
  return PaymentEnv
    { credentials   = creds
    , rateLimits    = rates
    , auditLog      = audit
    , maxAttempts   = 5
    , windowSeconds = 300
    , lockDuration  = 900
    }

writeAudit :: PaymentEnv -> ByteString -> String -> String -> IO ()
writeAudit env user action result = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let entry = AuditEntry now user action result
  modifyMVar_ (auditLog env) $ \log -> return (entry : log)
  hPutStrLn stderr $ "[AUDIT] " ++ show now ++ " user=" ++ BS.unpack user
                     ++ " action=" ++ action ++ " result=" ++ result

checkRateLimit :: PaymentEnv -> ByteString -> UTCTime -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit env user now = do
  limits <- readMVar (rateLimits env)
  case Map.lookup user limits of
    Nothing -> return True
    Just st -> case lockedUntil st of
      Just lockTime
        | now < lockTime -> return False
        | otherwise      -> return True
      Nothing ->
        let elapsed = diffUTCTime now (windowStart st)
        in if elapsed > windowSeconds env
           then return True
           else return (failedAttempts st < maxAttempts env)

updateRateLimit :: PaymentEnv -> ByteString -> Bool -> UTCTime -> IO ()
updateRateLimit env user success now =
  modifyMVar_ (rateLimits env) $ \limits -> do
    let current = Map.lookup user limits
    case (success, current) of
      (True, _) ->
        return $ Map.delete user limits
      (False, Nothing) ->
        return $ Map.insert user (RateLimitState 1 now Nothing) limits
      (False, Just st) ->
        let elapsed = diffUTCTime now (windowStart st)
            newSt = if elapsed > windowSeconds env
                    then RateLimitState 1 now Nothing
                    else let newFails = failedAttempts st + 1
                             lock = if newFails >= maxAttempts env
                                    then Just (addUTCTime (lockDuration env) now)
                                    else Nothing
                         in RateLimitState newFails (windowStart st) lock
        in return $ Map.insert user newSt limits

authenticateUser :: PaymentEnv -> ByteString -> ByteString -> IO AuthResult
authenticateUser env user password = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  allowed <- checkRateLimit env user now
  if not allowed
    then do
      writeAudit env user "auth_attempt" "rate_limited"
      return AuthLocked
    else do
      creds <- readMVar (credentials env)
      case Map.lookup user creds of
        Nothing -> do
          -- Perform a dummy bcrypt verification to keep timing constant
          -- with the existing-user path, preventing username enumeration.
          let _ = validatePassword password decoyHash
          _ <- (return $! _) :: IO ()
          updateRateLimit env user False now
          writeAudit env user "auth_attempt" "user_not_found"
          return AuthFailure
        Just storedHash -> do
          let valid = validatePassword password storedHash
          updateRateLimit env user valid now
          if valid
            then do
              writeAudit env user "auth_attempt" "success"
              return AuthSuccess
            else do
              writeAudit env user "auth_attempt" "invalid_password"
              return AuthFailure

processPayment :: PaymentEnv -> ByteString -> ByteString -> Double -> IO (Either String String)
processPayment env user password amount = do
  authResult <- authenticateUser env user password
  case authResult of
    AuthLocked -> do
      writeAudit env user "payment" "denied_locked"
      return $ Left "Account temporarily locked due to too many failed attempts"
    AuthFailure -> do
      writeAudit env user "payment" "denied_auth_failed"
      return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    AuthSuccess -> do
      writeAudit env user "payment" ("processed_" ++ show amount)
      return $ Right $ "Payment of $" ++ show amount ++ " processed for " ++ BS.unpack user

-- Batch authentication endpoint used by internal reconciliation service
-- Validates a list of credential pairs, returns which ones are valid
-- All attempts are rate-limited and audited
batchValidate :: PaymentEnv -> [(ByteString, ByteString)] -> IO [AuthResult]
batchValidate env pairs = do
  mapM (\(user, password) -> authenticateUser env user password) pairs
